description.zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

- 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

- 由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

- 长度为2~120个字符。
description.en:
The name of the IP address whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It must consist of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

- It must be 2 to 120 characters in length.
The ID of the IP address whitelist template.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-global-security-ip-group-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name test_123 --global-security-group-id g-zsldxfiwjmti0kcm0000 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
